description: S458 2a-fix F2, the negative twin: the runtime write-path judge does not refuse legitimate updates of a refined cell — a field write of 7, a `push` of 7, `@n++`, and writing `not` into `number(>0) | not` all apply.
rationale: §53.3.3: "The assignment is applied if and only if the predicate evaluates to true." `not` inhabits `T | not`.
